frontmatter_snapshot.summary: CB-arb cross-sectional factor scoring uses linear regression (OLS), ridge / lasso shrinkage for high-dimensional feature spaces, and boosting (AdaBoost / gradient boosting) for non-linear loadings. ESL Ch.3 supplies linear methods; ESL Ch.10 supplies boosting; Greene Ch.4 supplies the OLS foundation; Wooldridge Ch.7 supplies categorical dummies.
